The following events took place in '''150 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*At fifty years of age, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] left his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to explore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], as part of a typical Wookiee period of maturation called "[[The Rising Path]]."<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
